paper_metadata.title: Synergistic effect of Nb and Mo alloying on the microstructure and mechanical properties of CoCrFeNi high entropy alloy

evidence.quote: a series of CoCrFeNi-(Nb, Mo) high entropy alloys were prepared using vacuum arc-melting.

attributes.morphology: typical dendritic structure with interdendritic precipitates

evidence.quote: As illustrated in the low magnification images, all as-cast HEAs exhibit typical dendritic structure. The dendritic phase is FCC matrix and the interdendritic phases are precipitates.
